name: search_messages
description: Default function for iMessage recall and topic questions. Use when words like plan, group, contact, top, liked, or link are merely part of the topic rather than an explicit operation.

query.description: Literal topic words expected in message bodies; exclude request verbs, function names, people, dates, and range words

with.description: Contact name whose conversations to search

from.description: Sender contact name, or me for messages sent by the user

in.description: Date only: a known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: read_conversation
description: Read a one-to-one conversation chronologically. Use only when the user explicitly asks to catch up, inspect, or recall what a conversation was about.

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: count_messages
description: Return the exact number of iMessage messages matching words and optional person, sender, chat, media, reaction, and date filters. Use for how-many questions.

with.description: Contact name whose conversations to count

from.description: Sender contact name, or me for messages sent by the user

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: first_message
description: Return the earliest iMessage message matching words and optional person, sender, chat, media, reaction, and date filters. Use for first/earliest/when-did questions.

with.description: Contact name whose conversations to search

from.description: Sender contact name, or me for messages sent by the user

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: top_contacts
description: Rank people by iMessage volume. Use only when explicitly asked to rank contacts or who the user texts most; a contact name or the word top alone is insufficient.

chat.description: Optional group name whose members should be ranked

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: top_groups
description: Rank group chats by iMessage volume. Use only for an explicit most-active, biggest, or top-groups ranking request; do not use for a topic or named group.

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: overview_stats
description: Return total, sent, received, and distinct-chat iMessage counts for a date window. Use for overall messaging activity or summary totals.

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: friends_made_since
description: Find people whose iMessage relationship with the user began after a date. Use for new friends, people met, or friends made since a date.

name: plans_in_window
description: Find commitments the user made in sent iMessages. Use only when explicitly asked what plans or commitments the user made; do not use when plan/plans is merely a message topic.

in.description: Known window token, ISO date, or ISO date range

name: search_contacts
description: Search the user's iMessage contacts and people by name. Use to find whether a person/contact exists, not to search message bodies.
